corrected_fields.market_structure_context: The document establishes minimum capital standards and leverage ratio requirements for banks, affecting how banks manage their balance sheets and Treasury market participation. The output floor (phasing to 72.5% from 2022-2027) constrains the extent to which banks can use internal models to reduce capital requirements, directly impacting risk-weighted asset calculations. The revised standardised approach for credit risk and the finalised leverage ratio framework affect bank appetite for various credit exposures and their interactions with Treasury markets.
